question: Should ClawHub preserve lowercase/legacy skill readme aliases while rejecting case-colliding package paths, and should `PROTOCOL.md` be included in that collision policy?
rationale: Current docs and code deliberately accept lowercase and legacy aliases, while `PROTOCOL.md` is not currently a defined skill package contract, so automation should not choose the permanent package policy on its own.

options.title: Accept alias-preserving collision rejection
options.body: Land the linked PR shape that keeps accepted aliases but rejects packages containing conflicting case variants, with docs/specs and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Require uppercase-only canonical files
options.body: Change the package contract to require uppercase names and provide explicit migration guidance for existing lowercase or legacy packages.

options.title: Defer `PROTOCOL.md` enforcement
options.body: Limit the immediate fix to currently defined skill readme aliases and track any `PROTOCOL.md` package contract separately.

recommendation.title: Accept alias-preserving collision rejection
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR shape that keeps accepted aliases but rejects packages containing conflicting case variants, with docs/specs and real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current package contract and affected docs/validation lines blame to the v0.23.1 release-boundary commit authored by Patrick Erichsen.
